notes: 把「卸载/安装插件时报 Cannot find module ...\dependencies\pnpm\bin\pnpm.mjs」收进同步链。客户端把内置运行时放在 ~\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime，而装卸插件调用 pnpm 时拼的却是安装目录下的 resources\runtime\primary-runtime；客户端升级会重建并清空这个目录，链接随之消失，之后所有 link: 型插件的装卸一律失败（插件本身没坏，是 pnpm 找不到）。现在 apply 每次落地都幂等补回这层 junction：能解析出 pnpm.mjs 就报「已就绪」，已有真实运行时目录绝不覆盖只告警，目标机器还没装运行时就跳过并提示，不写坏任何文件。
notesEn: Folds the "Cannot find module ...\dependencies\pnpm\bin\pnpm.mjs on plugin install/uninstall" failure into the sync chain. The client keeps its bundled runtime at ~\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime, while the pnpm call used for plugin install/uninstall resolves it under the install directory at resources\runtime\primary-runtime; a client upgrade rebuilds and empties that directory, the link vanishes, and from then on every link:-style plugin install/uninstall fails (the plugin is fine, pnpm just cannot be found). apply now idempotently restores that junction on every run: it reports "ready" when pnpm.mjs resolves, never overwrites a real runtime directory (only warns), and skips with a hint when the machine has no runtime at all - without writing anything broken.
